fichas.title: Average life expectancy of building elements
fichas.summary: Lists typical life-expectancy groups for building and finishing elements, from up to 10 years to over 80 years. The text notes that construction quality and maintenance affect service life, and that accessible replaceable elements can reduce maintenance costs.

dimensions.label: Life expectancy group
dimensions.context: Upper limit for the listed elements, including lime-washed façades, external window paint, wallpaper, textile flooring, floor surface treatment, and pumps.

dimensions.label: Life expectancy group
dimensions.context: Upper limit for the listed elements, including felt roof covering, mineral paints, awnings, plastic external elements, double glazing, floor coverings, building services, and equipment.

dimensions.label: Life expectancy group
dimensions.context: Upper limit for the listed elements, including external render, pointing to facing brickwork, plastic windows, roof coverings, insulation systems, screed, installations, and lifts.

dimensions.label: Life expectancy group
dimensions.context: Upper limit for the listed elements, including external render, fair-faced concrete, roof construction, roof tiles, stairs, doors, windows, screeds, floor coverings, sanitary appliances, and drainpipes.

dimensions.label: Life expectancy group
dimensions.context: The listed elements are stated to have a life expectancy greater than this threshold; examples include massive construction, steel construction, façade cladding, roof construction, slate roofing, and selected windowsills.

fichas.title: Classification of work to existing buildings according to HOAI
fichas.summary: Explains categories of work on existing buildings, including maintenance, repair, modernisation, rebuilding, extensions, recreation, and conversion. A table compares selected measures by definition, costs, HOAI fee treatment, and approval requirement. Conversion may require building permission, and preliminary investigations and special services are recommended for refurbishment projects.

dimensions.label: Fee increase for phase 8
dimensions.context: Maintenance: increase of fee for phase 8 up to the stated amount.
dimensions.ocr_raw: increase of fee for phase 8 up to 50%

dimensions.label: Fee increase
dimensions.context: Table entries for modernisation, rebuilding, and extension state a fee increase up to the printed range.
dimensions.ocr_raw: increase of fee by up to 20--30%

fichas.title: Classification of works in light of listed-building issues
fichas.summary: Defines conservation, restoration, reconstruction, anastylose, and translocation in the context of historic monuments and listed buildings. The distinctions address preservation of historic fabric, recovery of historic appearance, recreation of destroyed buildings, reassembly from original elements, and relocation.
